lesson: Reciprocity identities act on the L-value variable (n or the spectral parameter) and leave the mollifier twist l fixed or turn it into a level; the saving n4 needs is cancellation in l, which none of them touches. Moving to weights that have a dual family replaces Katok-Sarnak positivity by functional-equation positivity, which E_a with real a also satisfies. P2 has an exact anchor B(t_rho) = -1 but no region of absolute convergence in t, so the convexity detector cannot be run.
